messages:
alina_partnerships: Heads-up : multiple partners reported confusion about who opens war rooms across marketplace, HW partners, and SIs. We need a small, unambiguous routing matrix and a required handback envelope.

marc_oncall: Agreed. Proposal: one shared first-hop channel per domain (e.g., #mp-partner-sev, #hw-partner-sev). Posting there with a short tag should be the single signal that triggers routing.

priya_sre: Operational rule: when a message contains TAG=<domain> ID=<id> the bot runs /open-war <domain>-<id> -> creates private warroom, posts triage snippet, and notifies both org oncalls. Also include an owner-lock field so the person who declares Owner: stays owner unless they release.

tom_partner_se: From partner side: require "relay-email:" and a public ticket stub. Also ask for a one-line public-status blurb we can copy to our status page.

sev_bot: /open-war accepted  channel #war-2210000000-mp created. Zoom: https://meet.redwood/war-2210000000. Triage snippet injected. Notifying @marc_oncall, @tom_partner_se. Runbook: https://confluence.redwood/partnerships/sev-routing-matrix

marc_oncall: Triage snippet (bot-inserted):
- Impact (prod/infra):
- Domain/Tag:
- ID:
- Relay-email:
- Owner (org:user) [owner-lockable]:
- Quick mitigations tried:
- Public status blurb: (one line)
- Escalation TTL (default 10m; partner override allowed)

priya_sre: Add handback envelope template (bot posts on resolve):
- Resolved: timestamp
- Remediation summary (1-2 lines)
- Artifacts: logs/commit/config diff links (public or SSO-safe)
- SI validation checklist (pass/fail rows)
- Confirmation: "SI will close their ticket" / "Redwood closes customer-facing item"

tom_partner_se: We'll map our automation to the TAG names and test. If you include the public-status blurb in the bot template it will reduce back-and-forth.

alina_partnerships: Next actions: 1) Marc to add /open-war hook to sev_bot (ETA 48h). 2) Priya to update runbook with owner-lock semantics + TTL overrides (ETA EOW). 3) Tom to share relay-email formats and status blurb examples (ETA 48h). 4) We'll run a 20m drill after bot change.

marc_oncall: I'll open a tiny PR to sev_bot today with minimal triage & handback payloads.

sev_bot: Reminder scheduled: "Partner SEV drill" in 7 days.

alina_partnerships: Thanks everyone 64f. Goal: deterministic routing + clear handback so partners and SIs stop paging multiple teams. If you see missing fields, call them out here.
